preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= N for x in stdin.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All integers in input (N, A, P, Q, x, y) are within bounds 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: len(A) == N and len(P) == N and all(1 <= a <= N for a in A) and all(1 <= p <= N for p in P)
preconditions.description: A and P are permutations of length N with distinct elements from 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N and x != y for line in operations if line.startswith('2'))
preconditions.description: In type-2 operations, x and y are distinct indices within bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N for line in operations if line.startswith('3'))
preconditions.description: In type-3 operations, x is a valid index within bounds.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == str(A_after_operations[x - 1]) for stdout_line, (op, x) in zip(output_lines, type3_queries) if op == '3')
postconditions.description: For each type-3 query, the output line is the element at position x in the current state of A after all preceding operations.
